CREATE SCHEMA Security
GO

-- Creation of security function.
-- Function to define what will be use as filter on tables
CREATE FUNCTION Security.AccessPredicate(@BankSK int, @SourceSystemCode varchar(50))
    RETURNS TABLE
WITH SCHEMABINDING
AS
    RETURN SELECT 1 AS AccessPredicateResult 
	FROM DW.RefRowLevelSecurity ref_rls INNER JOIN DW.DimBank Bank ON ref_rls.BankID = Bank.BankID
	WHERE ref_rls.UserEmail = USER_NAME() AND
	(	
		@BankSK = Bank.BankSK AND @SourceSystemCode = SourceSystemCode
		
	)
	OR IS_MEMBER('SOLVENTO_INFRA') = 0
GO
